modules.title: 怎样判断微调是否有帮助

items.title: 示例表达目标行为
items.text: 代表性的输入和期望输出用于继续训练模型；不存在适用于所有模型和任务的固定样本条数。

items.title: 用新输入验收
items.text: 训练样例不能证明新问题也能处理好。保留未参与训练的工单，按正确性、格式和语气比较结果。

modules.title: 微调不免除提示词，也不保证正确
modules.text: 微调让输出更贴近训练样例，不保证每个新输入都遵守样例或包含最新政策；动态信息应从可更新来源取得。

lessonPractice.title: 团队配置了一个客服模型。哪项证据表明本次实际用了微调模型？

options.label: 实际使用的模型版本有成对工单样例的继续训练记录
options.feedback: 这把当前使用的模型与训练过程连起来：用输入和期望回复继续训练已有模型，属于微调。

options.label: 本次请求的提示词增加了回复格式要求
options.feedback: 这会影响本次回答，但只是修改提示词，不能证明模型经过继续训练。

options.label: 本次检索命中了更新后的退货政策
options.feedback: 这为回答提供当前资料，属于检索链路；不能证明模型的训练发生了变化。

en.title: A team configured a support model. Which evidence shows this request actually used a fine-tuned model?

options.label: The model version in use has a training record based on paired support examples
options.feedback: This connects the model in use with further training on inputs and target replies: fine-tuning.

options.label: The current request adds reply-format requirements to its prompt
options.feedback: That can influence this answer, but changing a prompt does not show the model was trained further.

options.label: Retrieval found the updated return policy for this request
options.feedback: That supplies current source material through retrieval, not evidence of further model training.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 先不要开始训练。请用几条真实客服工单和期望回复改进提示词，并用另外一组没参与整理的工单检查格式和语气；如果仍不稳定，再说明微调方案需要什么数据、怎样评估，以及它不能保证什么。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Do not start training yet. First use real support tickets and target replies to improve the prompt, then check tone and format on a separate set of tickets. If it is still inconsistent, explain what data fine-tuning would use, how you would evaluate it, and what it cannot guarantee.

learning.assumes: You have seen AI answer from a prompt but struggle to keep one kind of task consistent with team examples.
learning.outcome: You can tell what prompts, retrieved material, and fine-tuning each change, and know to evaluate with new examples.

modules.title: What does fine-tuning change in a support task?

example.label: Teaching example: support samples, training, and a new ticket check

steps.label: State the target reply
steps.demo:
Support · refund question
Support ticket · teaching exampleGoal: outcome first, next step second
Customer messageThe cup is unopened. Can I return it?
Current replyFind the return option on the order page. Unused products can be returned.
steps.caption: Teaching example: the team names a concrete difference—the reply should state the outcome before the next step.

steps.label: Train further on paired examples
steps.demo:
Support examples · teaching case
InputThe cup is unopened. Can I return it?
Target replyYou can request a return. Submit it on the order page; eligibility follows the current policy.
steps.caption: An input and target reply form one example. Data requirements and training methods depend on the model and task.

steps.label: Evaluate on a new ticket
steps.demo:
Support · new ticket
New ticket · teaching exampleCurrent task instructions still apply
New questionHow do I return the unused kettle from my order?
Policy in this exampleUnused products can be returned through the order page
Model replyYou can request a return for the unused kettle. Choose “Request return” on the order page.
Acceptance checkOutcome first, next step second; matches this example’s policy
steps.caption: This is not a measured training result. Compare multiple tickets excluded from training for format, tone, and factual accuracy.

modules.title: How to tell whether fine-tuning helped

items.title: Examples show the target behavior
items.text: Representative inputs and target outputs provide examples for further training. There is no single sample count that fits every model and task.

items.title: Evaluate on new inputs
items.text: Training examples do not prove that new requests will work. Keep tickets outside the training set and compare correctness, format, and tone.

modules.title: Fine-tuning does not remove prompts or guarantee correctness
modules.text: It makes outputs better match training examples; it does not guarantee every new answer follows them or knows current policy. Use an updatable source for changing information.

distinctions.label: Prompt
distinctions.text: A prompt states the task and requirements for the current request; fine-tuning trains further on input and target-output examples. A fine-tuned model may still need prompts for the current goal and context.

distinctions.label: RAG
distinctions.text: RAG retrieves external material when answering; fine-tuning makes the model better match training examples. For changing refund policies, check current material rather than assuming a fine-tune updates itself.
